tasks.label: Zoomdeck: preview
tasks.detail: Serve the deck of the current file; the browser reloads on every save and keeps its position. E or Alt+click in the browser opens the source line here.

tasks.label: Zoomdeck: jump to this line
tasks.detail: Show the stop of the cursor line in the running preview.

tasks.label: Zoomdeck: build HTML
tasks.detail: Export the deck of the current file as one self-contained HTML file in ./build.
